notes: Cash basis county. Statement receipts/disbursements from Total Governmental Funds column (p4). Taxes 8,417,141 split using Statement of Activities general receipts (p2: Property 7,192,112 + Motor vehicle 743,307 + Lodging 481,722 = 8,417,141); Local 1,857,972 split using SoA charges for services 1,378,168 + interest income 265,627 + miscellaneous 214,177 (exact, as in FY2024). Debt service 'Principal and interest' kept combined as printed on p4 (combining pages print principal/interest by fund). Fund balances from p4; ending_cash = Cash + Restricted cash on p3 (no beginning cash printed). Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement p3 (totals equal government-wide p1). Detail: General Fund column from the budgetary comparison schedule p14 (department lines, not itemized); other General Fund sub-fund columns (Reappraisal Sinking, Inheritance Tax, County Medical Relief, State Institutions, Veteran's Aid) from the combining pages p5-6; Road, COVID ARPA and Highway Allocation Capital Projects funds from their budget schedules p15-17; nonmajor funds per fund column from the combining pages p7-13 (Employment Security Fund had no activity). Fund-level taxes not split except visitors funds (lodging by fund name). COVID ARPA 'Operating expense' 650,000 placed in streets/highways because the statement p4 prints it as Public works. Highway Allocation Capital Projects Fund prints no revenue/expenditure totals (single lines). Read pages 1-17 of 17
